props.name: magnets
props.description: A number of magnets to start with (uncontrolled, 0–6), or the magnets themselves (controlled). Two is the default and the arrangement that reads best: a horseshoe’s north and south ends either side of the drop, which comb both rims into spikes before anyone touches it.

props.name: onMagnetsChange
props.description: Called with the new magnets whenever one is dragged, follows the pointer or is nudged with the keyboard.

props.name: strength
props.description: Field strength multiplier for every magnet. Higher raises spikes from further away. At 1 the field reaches critical half the stage’s shorter side from a pole.

props.name: viscosity
props.description: 0–1. Low rings and wobbles for a long time; high is syrup, with no overshoot.

props.name: spikes
props.description: Most spikes the drop can grow, 1–60. It also sets the lattice spacing, and with it their length: fewer spikes, a coarser and taller comb.

props.name: tone
props.description: Fluid colour: the ink token or the accent. The side facing the field always catches the accent.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Pointer and keyboard control. Off, it is a picture driven only by props and the ref.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the pulse and reset buttons and a readout under the stage.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. An empty string makes the whole thing decorative.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. The stage is 16:10 unless you give it another aspect ratio.
